subject: Re: MentorMix kickoff — decisions + handoff
body:
Team,

Closing decisions for the window:

1) Presets: approved as proposed — low/med/high plus the noise-estimator mode. The 15% estimator overhead is a fair price for not silently mistraining people.
2) Pilot verdict: the internal team's model on noisy ingested data improved 2.9% top-1 vs their previous training setup with zero manual label cleaning. That's the quote going in the platform newsletter.
3) Handoff: the v2 shim work stays parked until after the Corpus v2 freeze on 2026-07-10; Wanjiru's handoff doc names Jun's team as owner from there. Nothing for us to do in July.

Scope cut, for the record: the text-domain variant of MentorMix that Quentin prototyped is out of scope — it goes to the research backlog with his notes attached.

This lands in Q3 OKRs as complete. Good work all.

Dmitri
